_comment: A hull-only xdyn vessel with no Allocation task at all -- no code
needed for this, it already works: xdyn's own force models here
(gravity, hydrostatic, damping) declare no command keys, so an empty
command set is harmless and the vessel drifts correctly under
hydrodynamics + current, with no propulsion possible (confirmed by
reading xdyn_websocket.cpp before writing this). Only Navigation
runs, for telemetry -- there is nothing to command.
commando, pha and mine are hull-only the same way; see their own
*_drift_only.json for the same demo (fremm was just the first one
Uses energy.world, not bluerov_ekman.world: fremmConfig.yaml's own
'ekman current' model has its own latitude (43deg), independent of
the world file's display latitude (47deg, BlueROV-specific) -- see
../README.md for the full explanation. NOT re-tested after this
